profile.text:
Adnachiel is a citizen of Laterano and enjoys rights one through thirteen afforded to all citizens of Laterano. Before his arrival at Rhodes Island, he worked as a freelancer. He received excellent results on a battery of tests and was assigned to Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4.
He has demonstrated great potential in the areas of rapid response, marksmanship, and support operations.
